description: This Java source file defines a WebDriverFactory class responsible for creating WebDriver instances for Selenium tests. It supports local and remote WebDriver creation modes based on environment variables and configuration, including specific browser options for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.

classes.name: WebDriverFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for creating WebDriver instances for Selenium tests based on configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a WebDriver instance based on the given configuration, respecting discovery mode and remote/local execution modes.

methods.name: createRemote
methods.description: Creates a RemoteWebDriver connected to a Selenium Grid URL with specified browser and headless options.

methods.name: createLocal
methods.description: Creates a local WebDriver instance for Chrome, Firefox, or Edge based on the specified browser name and headless flag.

methods.name: buildCapabilities
methods.description: Builds browser-specific capabilities and options based on browser name and whether headless mode is enabled.
